Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference — welcome!

If you'd like a short live demo (30 minutes) to see how Redwood can reduce inference cost and improve latency for your use cases, you can book a time that works for you here: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30

- 15m: live demo (console + runtime)
- 5m: next steps & pricing

If you prefer, reply to this email and a member of our team will reach out to schedule.

— The Redwood Team
